summary.text: Matthew Sergent is the Republican candidate for Missouri House of Representatives District 57 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democrat Michael Walbom.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as business owner.

paragraphs.text: Sergent previously ran in the August 6, 2024 Republican primary for Missouri House of Representatives District 54, which Brandon Phelps won.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he named fighting for freedoms, standing up for small business, and lowering the state budget as his key messages.
He listed education and small business as his policy interests.
